hierarchy.h4: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#A1A1AA] font-mono font-semibold

sections.header: col-span-full flex justify-between items-end border-b border-white/10 pb-4 mb-6
sections.activity_feed: col-span-1 lg:col-span-7 h-64 overflow-y-auto border border-white/10 bg-[#0A0A0A] p-4
sections.legend: col-span-1 lg:col-span-5 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2
sections.info_section: col-span-full border border-white/10 bg-[#121212] p-6 lg:p-8 mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8

surfaces.focused_device_indicator: absolute top-0 left-0 w-1 h-full bg-[#00E5FF]
surfaces.hud_video_container: relative w-full aspect-video bg-black border border-white/15 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center

components.buttons: rounded-none font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-all duration-200. Primary: bg-[#FFB300] text-black hover:bg-[#FFC107]. Secondary: border border-white/20 hover:border-white/40 bg-transparent text-white.
components.badges: rounded-sm font-mono text-xs uppercase px-2 py-1 bg-white/10 border border-white/20 text-white inline-flex items-center gap-1
components.active_badges: rounded-sm font-mono text-xs uppercase px-2 py-1 bg-[#00E5FF]/20 border border-[#00E5FF]/50 text-[#00E5FF] inline-flex items-center gap-1
components.sliders: Use Shadcn slider. Override track to bg-[#3F3F46] and active range/thumb to bg-[#00E5FF].
components.switches: Use Shadcn switch. Override rounded-full to rounded-sm. Active state bg-[#FFB300].
components.terminal_log: font-mono text-sm border-b border-white/5 py-2 flex items-start gap-3
components.gesture_card: bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 p-3 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-center

icons.usage: Use strokeWidth={1.5}. For active states, use strokeWidth={2} and color them with #FFB300 or #00E5FF.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts in global CSS or index.html: Outfit (Headings), Manrope (Body), JetBrains Mono (Data/Code).
Do NOT use `border-radius` (rounded corners) extensively. Use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` for an industrial, precise control-room aesthetic.

Webcam Feed: Implement the MediaPipe integration within a robust HUD container (styled with corner brackets and crosshairs to look like a targeting system/HUD). Overlay the real-time gesture name and confidence score on this feed using large JetBrains Mono text.

Device Control Panel: Build rectangular, flat cards for Living Room Light, Bedroom Light, and Ceiling Fan. When a device is 'focused' (selected via gesture), highlight it with a left border (`border-l-4`) or background tint using the secondary color (#00E5FF).
Gesture Legend: Map out Open Palm (ON), Fist (OFF), Thumbs Up (Up), Thumbs Down (Down), Peace (Next), Point (Select) using small grid cards.
Activity Feed: Style as a scrolling terminal log. Use a monospace font, showing timestamp (e.g., [14:32:01]) and the detected action (e.g., COMMAND_LIVING_ROOM_ON).
Status Indicators: Place at the top right of the dashboard. Use small dots (green/amber) and mono text (e.g., CAMERA: ONLINE).
Ensure the UI meets accessibility standards. The dark theme (#050505) with white (#F8F9FA) text has high contrast. Use the primary yellow (#FFB300) for high-alert interactions or active states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='device-card-living-light').
